Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the 
applicant in C528 Nos.1708 of 2026 and 1709 of 
2026.
2. Mr. Shashi Kant Shandilya, learned counsel 
for the applicant in C528 No.1699 of 2026.
3. Mr. Amit Bhatt, learned Government 
Advocate assisted by Mr. Tumul K Nainwal, 
learned AGA for the State of Uttarakhand.
4. This Court is not convinced with the affidavit 
filed by the Director General of Police, since only 
the reference of certain circulars have been given 
whereby the instructions have been issued to the 
Officials to follow the guidelines of the Hon’ble  Apex Court time to time, but the real fact is that 
there is no compliance of the guidelines issued by 
the Hon’ble Apex Court. 
5. This Court has also observed in so many cases 
that in most of the cases, the investigation is faulty.
6. Let a fresh affidavit be filed in this regard.
Secretary, Home shall also file affidavit.
7. In addition to this, learned AGA may also get 
the instructions in C528 No.1708 of 2026 from the 
concerned Investigating Officer what evidence he 
has collected to find out how the informant has 
paid such a huge amount in cash, which is wholly 
impermissible as per the Income Tax Act.
8. List these matters on 15.09.2026 under the 
same caption. 
 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 08.09.2026
Nitesh/

Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for 
the applicant.
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned AGA for the 
State.
3. Respondent no. 2 Atul Chhabra- the 
informant of FIR dated 15.10.2025 sent an e￾mail on the official website of this Court that 
that he was called to appear through the 
Investigating Officer only one day before the 
hearing, and, since, he did not receive proper 
and reasonable prior notice enabling him to 
consult and engage an Advocate, therefore, he 
requests that he may be given reasonable time 
to engage an Advocate and further requests 
that the hearing of these matters be deferred 
to a subsequent date. Copy of e-mail is placed 
on record.
4. Since, a genuine request is made by 
respondent no. 2, therefore, the matter is 
posted on 03.11.2026 so that respondent no. 
2 may engage a lawyer.
5. The matter not be treated as part heard 
and the Registry is directed to list this matter, 
as per the roster, before the appropriate 
Bench.
(Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
